r.s: PHP library to parse and generate "Extensible Resource Descriptor" (XRD + JRD) files
r.d:
PHP library to parse and generate "Extensible Resource Descriptor (XRD) Version 1.0" files.
XRD and JRD files are used for ".well-known/host-meta" files as standardized in "RFC 6415: Web Host Metadata", as well as in the "LRDD (Link-based Resource Descriptor Discovery)" files linked from it.
The XRD format supercedes the XRDS format defined in XRI 2.0, which is used in the Yadis communications protocol.
r.n: - Full JRD loading and saving support - BC break: toXML() deprecated.
